title: Honest
subtitle: 本課限定語境：honest = telling the truth, expressing real thoughts or feelings, and not deliberat
description: 本課限定語境：honest = telling the truth, expressing real thoughts or feelings, and not deliberately deceiving others · 「誠實的；坦白的；真誠的」

words.note: 表示不說謊，所說內容符合事實。
words.example: She gave a truthful account of what happened.
words.exampleZh: 她如實講述了事情經過。

exercises.original: The witness gave an honest account of what she had seen.
exercises.zh: 目擊者如實講述了她看到的事情。
exercises.upgrade: The witness gave a truthful account of what she had seen.

options.explanation: 可表示她真心，但不直接保證內容符合事實。
account of what she had seen 的核心是如實陳述。
偏坦率，不一定強調內容完全真實。
可表示內容準確，但沒有「不撒謊」的道德意味。
副詞，不能直接修飾名詞 account。

exercises.original: Please give me an honest answer about what happened.
exercises.zh: 請如實回答發生了甚麼事。
exercises.upgrade: Please give me a truthful answer about what happened.

options.explanation: 要求對方說真話，最精確。
也可表示坦白，但更偏表達直接。
表示直接清楚，未必特別強調真實性。
通常形容感情／反應真誠，不常形容 factual answer。

exercises.original: He has always been honest about his past.
exercises.zh: 他一直如實談及自己的過去。
exercises.upgrade: He has always been truthful about his past.

options.explanation: 重點是談及過去時沒有說謊。
是真心，但不一定表示所有細節都如實。
也很自然，強調願意分享；但 truthful 更直接對應「沒有說謊」。
表示值得信任，範圍更廣。

words.note: 表示感情、態度、道歉、感謝等是真心的。

exercises.original: She gave an honest apology after realizing her mistake.
exercises.zh: 她意識到錯誤後作出了真誠道歉。
exercises.upgrade: She gave a sincere apology.

options.explanation: 可以坦率承認問題，但 candid apology 不是最自然搭配。
apology 的核心是是否真心。
道歉不是主要在判斷事實真假。
偏直接，不表示真心程度。

exercises.original: His honest thanks meant a lot to the volunteers.
exercises.zh: 他真誠的感謝令義工很感動。
exercises.upgrade: His sincere thanks meant a lot to the volunteers.

options.explanation: 也很自然，表示不是假裝。
sincere thanks 是非常常見搭配。
與感謝的真心程度無關。

exercises.original: She seemed honest when she said she wanted to help.
exercises.zh: 她說想幫忙時看來是真心的。
exercises.upgrade: She seemed sincere when she said she wanted to help.

options.explanation: 可以表示話是真的，但此處重點是意圖真心。
wanted to help 涉及真實意圖和感情。

words.note: 表示願意公開說出真正想法，不刻意隱藏。
words.example: She was candid about the difficulties the team faced.
words.exampleZh: 她坦率談到團隊面對的困難。

exercises.original: She was honest about the difficulties the project had faced.
exercises.zh: 她坦率談到項目曾面對的困難。
exercises.upgrade: She was candid about the difficulties the project had faced.

options.explanation: 願意公開談及不利資訊，是典型 candid。
也可，但不突出「不隱瞞困難」的坦率。

exercises.original: The manager gave an honest assessment of the team's weaknesses.
exercises.zh: 經理對團隊弱點作出了坦率評估。
exercises.upgrade: The manager gave a candid assessment of the team's weaknesses.

options.explanation: candid assessment 是固定而自然的正式搭配。

exercises.original: We had an honest conversation about why the plan had failed.
exercises.zh: 我們就計劃失敗原因進行了一次坦率對話。
exercises.upgrade: We had a candid conversation about why the plan had failed.

options.explanation: 公開討論敏感／不利問題，很自然。
語義可理解，但 truthful conversation 不如 candid 自然。
可表示真誠，但不突出坦率討論問題。
可能過度直接甚至不禮貌。
名詞，而且 candour 更常見。

words.note: 表示直接、清楚地說出真正看法。
words.example: To be frank, the proposal needs more work.
words.exampleZh: 坦白說，這份建議書仍需進一步改善。

exercises.original: To be honest, I do not think the proposal is ready.
exercises.zh: 坦白說，我認為這份建議書還未準備好。
exercises.upgrade: To be frank, I do not think the proposal is ready.

options.explanation: 不能自然用在 to be sincere 作此固定開場。
to be frank 是標準固定表達。
to be truthful 可理解但不如 to be frank 自然。

exercises.original: He was honest with me about how poor my first draft was.
exercises.zh: 他坦白告訴我，我的初稿寫得有多差。
exercises.upgrade: He was frank with me about how poor my first draft was.

options.explanation: 直接說出可能令人不舒服的評價，是典型 frank。
也可能是真的，但少了「坦白直說」語氣。
可能與這種直接批評相反。

exercises.original: They had an honest discussion about the budget problems.
exercises.zh: 他們就預算問題作了坦白討論。
exercises.upgrade: They had a frank discussion about the budget problems.

options.explanation: 不如 frank 自然修飾 discussion。
也可表示直接，但 frank discussion 更固定。
直接面對問題、不迴避，最自然。
表示願意接受不同觀點。

words.meaning: 直接坦率的；不拐彎抹角的
words.note: 表示說話方式直接、清楚，不刻意模糊。
words.example: He gave me a straightforward answer.
words.exampleZh: 他給了我一個直接坦率的回答。

exercises.original: She gave me an honest answer instead of avoiding the question.
exercises.zh: 她沒有迴避問題，而是給了我直接坦率的回答。
exercises.upgrade: She gave me a straightforward answer.

options.explanation: 也可能正確，但題句特別說「沒有迴避」，更突出直接性。
直接回答、不繞圈子，最精確。
也接近，較強調坦率公開。

exercises.original: I appreciate his honest way of explaining problems.
exercises.zh: 我欣賞他直接清楚地解釋問題的方式。
exercises.upgrade: I appreciate his straightforward way of explaining problems.

options.explanation: 不形容解釋方式最自然。

exercises.original: The interviewer asked for an honest explanation of the delay.
exercises.zh: 面試官要求對方直接清楚地解釋延誤原因。
exercises.upgrade: The interviewer asked for a straightforward explanation of the delay.

options.explanation: 要求直接、不迴避、清楚解釋，最合適。

words.note: 表示非常直接、毫不迴避地表達意見。
words.example: She was forthright about the project's weaknesses.
words.exampleZh: 她毫不迴避地指出項目的弱點。

exercises.original: She was honest about the weaknesses in the proposal.
exercises.zh: 她毫不迴避地指出建議書的弱點。
exercises.upgrade: She was forthright about the weaknesses in the proposal.

options.explanation: 直接面對缺點、毫不迴避，最貼切。
表示沒有說謊，但少了強烈直接感。

exercises.original: The director gave an honest response to criticism from staff.
exercises.zh: 主管對員工批評作出了直率回應。
exercises.upgrade: The director gave a forthright response to criticism from staff.

options.explanation: 直接、不迴避批評，是最強烈的坦率語氣之一。

exercises.original: He is known for being honest even when his views are unpopular.
exercises.zh: 即使觀點不受歡迎，他仍以直言不諱著稱。
exercises.upgrade: He is known for being forthright even when his views are unpopular.

options.explanation: 也表示說真話，但不突出勇於直接表達不受歡迎觀點。
強調敢於直接說出真正立場。

words.meaning: 坦誠的；願意公開說明的
words.note: 表示願意分享真實想法、感受或資訊，不刻意隱瞞。
words.example: He was open about his concerns.
words.exampleZh: 他坦誠談及自己的憂慮。

exercises.original: She was honest about feeling nervous before the presentation.
exercises.zh: 她坦誠表示簡報前感到緊張。
exercises.upgrade: She was open about feeling nervous before the presentation.

options.explanation: 也可，但本句更強調願意分享自己的感受。
open about feelings 是非常自然搭配。

exercises.original: The company should be honest about why the change is necessary.
exercises.zh: 公司應坦誠說明為何有必要作出改變。
exercises.upgrade: The company should be open about why the change is necessary.

options.explanation: 公司願意公開解釋原因，是 openness 的核心。
也重要，但沒有突出資訊公開程度。

exercises.original: He has always been honest with colleagues about his concerns.
exercises.zh: 他一直坦誠地向同事說明自己的憂慮。
exercises.upgrade: He has always been open with colleagues about his concerns.

options.explanation: 副詞，句法不合 been 後位置。
open with someone about something 是標準結構。
偏真心，不表示願意分享。
也可，但焦點是資訊是否真，而不是 openness。

words.note: 表示感情、反應或態度並非假裝。
words.exampleZh: 她的關心看來是真誠的。

exercises.original: Her honest concern for the injured worker was obvious.
exercises.zh: 她對受傷工人的真誠關心十分明顯。
exercises.upgrade: Her genuine concern for the injured worker was obvious.

options.explanation: 表示關心不是假裝，而是真心的。

exercises.original: His honest enthusiasm made the audience trust him.
exercises.zh: 他真誠的熱情令觀眾信任他。
exercises.upgrade: His genuine enthusiasm made the audience trust him.

options.explanation: 表示熱情是真實的、不是裝出來的。

exercises.original: She gave an honest smile when she saw the children.
exercises.zh: 她看到孩子時露出真誠的笑容。
exercises.upgrade: She gave a genuine smile when she saw the children.

options.explanation: smile 是自然情感反應，genuine 最自然。

words.meaning: 公開正當的；光明正大的
words.note: 表示做法、交易或安排沒有欺騙或隱瞞。
words.exampleZh: 這宗交易看來完全公開正當。

exercises.original: The business deal appears completely honest and legal.
exercises.zh: 這宗商業交易看來完全公開正當。
exercises.upgrade: The business deal appears completely aboveboard.

options.explanation: 通常形容人、陳述，不自然形容交易本身。
交易透明、正當、沒有暗中欺騙，是典型用法。

exercises.original: The arrangement was honest, with all fees clearly disclosed.
exercises.zh: 這項安排公開正當，所有費用都清楚披露。
exercises.upgrade: The arrangement was aboveboard, with all fees clearly disclosed.

options.explanation: 也可表示安排簡單清楚，但不一定表示沒有暗中不當行為。
fees clearly disclosed 是透明正當的直接線索。

exercises.original: They wanted to make sure the transaction was completely honest.
exercises.zh: 他們想確保交易完全光明正大。
exercises.upgrade: They wanted to make sure the transaction was completely aboveboard.

options.explanation: 可以表示交易是真實的而非假交易，但不等於合法透明。
transaction 是最典型搭配之一。

falseSynonyms.zh: 值得信任 ≠ 誠實的直接同義詞 誠實可以令人 trustworthy，但 trustworthy 還包含可靠、守信等。
有禮貌 ≠ 誠實 一個人可以很有禮貌但不說真話。
準確 ≠ 誠實 資料可以準確，但「honest」還涉及是否故意欺騙。
直白 ≠ 必然誠實 blunt 強調說話直接甚至不顧禮貌，不保證內容真實。
忠誠 ≠ 誠實 loyal 是忠於某人／組織，不等於 truthful。
真實／本真的 ≠ 所有 honest authentic 常形容物品、風格、身份或自我表達，並非一般「說真話」。
詞形陷阱 - honest = 形容詞 - honestly = 副詞 - honesty = 名詞
詞形不同 - sincere = 真誠的 - sincerely = 真誠地 - sincerity = 真誠
